name: Atrial Fibrillation
subtitle: Irregular atrial rhythm
findings: Irregularly irregular rhythm; no distinct P waves; fibrillatory baseline.

name: Atrial Flutter
subtitle: Sawtooth atrial activity
findings: Sawtooth flutter waves; atrial rate typically 250–350/min; fixed or variable AV conduction.

name: Ventricular Tachycardia
subtitle: Wide-complex tachycardia
findings: Regular wide-complex tachycardia; QRS ≥120 ms; AV dissociation may be present.

name: Ventricular Fibrillation
subtitle: Disorganized ventricular activity
findings: Chaotic, irregular waveform with no identifiable P waves, QRS complexes, or T waves.

name: PSVT
subtitle: Abrupt-onset narrow tachycardia
findings: Regular narrow-complex tachycardia with abrupt onset and termination; P waves often hidden.

name: WPW Syndrome
subtitle: Accessory-pathway conduction
findings: Short PR interval, delta wave (slurred QRS upstroke), and widened QRS complex.

name: STEMI
subtitle: Acute ST elevation pattern
findings: ST elevation in ≥2 contiguous leads; reciprocal ST depression may be present.

name: NSTEMI
subtitle: Subendocardial ischemia pattern
findings: ST depression and/or T-wave inversion; no persistent diagnostic ST elevation.

name: Brugada Syndrome
subtitle: Right-precordial ST pattern
findings: Coved or saddleback ST elevation in V1–V3, often with a pseudo-RBBB appearance.

name: Right Bundle Branch Block
subtitle: Delayed right ventricular activation
findings: QRS ≥120 ms; rsR′ in V1; broad terminal S wave in leads I and V6.

name: Left Bundle Branch Block
subtitle: Delayed left ventricular activation
findings: QRS ≥120 ms; broad/notched R in I, aVL, V5–V6; predominantly negative V1.

name: Complete AV Block
subtitle: Complete atrioventricular dissociation
findings: P waves and QRS complexes occur independently; atrial rate exceeds ventricular rate.

name: Hyperkalemia
subtitle: Potassium-related repolarization changes
findings: Tall peaked T waves; severe cases may show PR prolongation, QRS widening, or sine-wave pattern.

name: Hypokalemia
subtitle: Potassium-related repolarization changes
findings: ST depression, flattened T waves, and prominent U waves; apparent QT prolongation.

name: Long QT Syndrome
subtitle: Delayed ventricular repolarization
findings: Prolonged QTc interval; may have broad-based or notched T waves.

name: Heart Failure
subtitle: Decompensated cardiac function
findings: Clinical syndrome: congestion and impaired cardiac output; ECG findings depend on the underlying cause.

name: AED / Defibrillation
subtitle: VF counter · restore organized rhythm
findings: Counter card: removes the VF lock and its acute VF damage effect from your side.

name: Insulin + Glucose
subtitle: Lower serum potassium
findings: Counter card: shifts potassium intracellularly and lowers hyperkalemia stacks; does not replace definitive potassium removal.

name: Calcium Gluconate
subtitle: Membrane stabilization
findings: Counter card: temporarily stabilizes the cardiac membrane against hyperkalemic arrhythmia; does not lower serum potassium.

name: Potassium Replacement
subtitle: Correct potassium deficit
findings: Counter card: removes the hypokalemia effect in this simplified game.

name: Revascularization
subtitle: Ischemia counter
findings: Counter card: clears the ischemia effect and restores a small amount of game health.

name: Diuretic Therapy
subtitle: Relieve congestion
findings: Counter card: clears the heart-failure status and restores 3 game health.

name: Catheter Ablation
subtitle: AF counter · restore organized rhythm
findings: Counter card: removes the atrial-fibrillation status and restores 2 game health.

name: Amiodarone
subtitle: VT counter · restore organized rhythm
findings: Counter card: removes the ventricular-tachycardia status and restores 2 game health.

name: Torsades de Pointes
subtitle: Polymorphic ventricular tachycardia
findings: Polymorphic VT associated with prolonged QT interval.

name: Sick Sinus Syndrome
subtitle: Sinus node dysfunction
findings: Sinus pauses and bradycardia caused by sinus node dysfunction.

name: Mobitz I
subtitle: Wenckebach AV block
findings: Progressive PR prolongation followed by a dropped beat.

name: Mobitz II
subtitle: High-grade AV block
findings: Fixed PR interval with intermittent dropped QRS complexes.

name: Junctional Rhythm
subtitle: AV junction escape rhythm
findings: Absent or retrograde P waves with narrow QRS complexes.

name: Wellens Syndrome
subtitle: Critical LAD stenosis
findings: Deeply inverted or biphasic T waves in anterior leads.

name: Prinzmetal Angina
subtitle: Coronary vasospasm
findings: Transient ST elevation caused by coronary spasm.

name: Old Myocardial Infarction
subtitle: Pathologic Q wave
findings: Persistent pathologic Q waves from prior infarction.

name: Cardiogenic Shock
subtitle: Severe pump failure
findings: Profound cardiac output reduction following severe myocardial dysfunction.

name: Hypercalcemia
subtitle: Shortened QT interval
findings: Short QT interval due to elevated serum calcium.

name: Hypocalcemia
subtitle: QT prolongation
findings: QT prolongation due to reduced serum calcium.
